gaps.title: COS auto-suspends between sessions
gaps.description: COS Fly machine 286d20be2700e8 (creatoros-app) suspended again between C27.1 and C27.2. Recurring problem — Fly suspends idle machines on free/hobby tier.
gaps.evidence: 2026-06-23T08:10: flyctl machines list shows suspended. Started again with flyctl machines start. This is the second suspension in this campaign.
gaps.remediation: Set min_machines_running=1 in fly.toml or switch to always-on. Or accept and document as expected behavior for pre-revenue.

gaps.title: Fly app names drifted from session records
gaps.description: Previous session recorded creator-os/entrepreneur-os but actual Fly apps are creatoros-app/eos-app. Reality-belief divergence in session state.
gaps.evidence: flyctl apps list shows: creatoros-app, eos-app, lyfeos-app, umh-cockpit. Previous delta report used wrong hostnames.
gaps.remediation: Correct all references. Add to device_registry or projection config.

gaps.title: COS PostHog analytics not operational
gaps.description: VITE_POSTHOG_KEY not set at COS build time. PostHog JS loads but has no project key, so no analytics data flows.
gaps.evidence: Bundle search for phc_ returns no matches. PostHog init present but key is empty/undefined.
gaps.remediation: Set VITE_POSTHOG_KEY in COS Fly build secrets or fly.toml [build.args]

gaps.title: Previous EOS audit tested wrong API paths
gaps.description: C27.1 EOS audit tested /api/ai/chat, /api/agent-actions, /api/gmail, /api/settings — all wrong paths. Actual routes: /api/ai-assistant/messages, /api/actions, /api/integrations/gmail/status, /api/keys/save. 4 capabilities were incorrectly classified as NOT_OPERATIONAL.
gaps.evidence: GitHub routes.ts audit confirmed correct paths. Live re-test: all 4 return 401 JSON (auth-gated, operational). EOS corrected from 16/22 to 20/22 operational.
gaps.remediation: RESOLVED — delta report corrected. Future audits must verify route paths from source code before declaring NOT_OPERATIONAL.
